# File `post-checkout`

Reconcile submodules after Git changes the checked-out commit.

Git calls this hook after checkout and switch. Its old/new HEAD arguments do not need interpretation: the gitlinks in the newly checked-out tree are the complete desired state, and sync-submodules owns the shared update policy.

[Source](../../hooks/post-checkout)
